desc: Approach selection: switch from gap-scan to O(n log n) segment tree with point updates.
Implement the compact segment-tree solution in the starter code (active/inactive node stats, process only negative values with count < n, update/query/revert).
Validate with examples, brute-force on small random arrays (all-negative, all-same, zeros, mixed, consecutive occurrences), and a 10^5 performance test.
